title: Common problems
summary: Quick fixes for the usual hosting troubles.

sections.heading: The server crashes or stops on start
steps: Open the Logs page. The tool writes what happened and what to do.
If it says the server cannot load a DLL, click the red Unblock DLLs button, then start again.
If it says Burning Empires is missing or the wrong version, click Install or repair Burning Empires.
Installing by hand? Get Burning Empires 2.0.2 from Nexus Mods. Install the main file first, then the hotfix.
If it says a Workshop mod is missing, subscribe to Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx. If MCM is missing, get it from Nexus Mods. Then start again.
With extra mods, try the locked Burning Empires setup. If that works, use Test mods on the server to find the mod.

sections.heading: Windows only
steps: A Burning Empires server only runs on Windows. Linux hosted servers cannot run it, because it needs UIExtenderEx and MCM.
Prepare server copies the Burning Empires files the server needs from your own game, so keep the game installed on this PC.

sections.heading: Mods do not match
steps: When a player's mods differ, the Logs page says which mods are missing or do not match.
Click Share mod list and have the player use Import mod list in the client launcher.
The player picks the same setup, with the same mods in the same order.

sections.heading: Black terrain and old screens
steps: Parts of the map can show black terrain. This is a known Burning Empires issue, not a problem with your server.
Population and religion screens on players' PCs can be out of date until they rejoin.

sections.heading: Get help
steps: Click Send my logs on the left. The password and addresses are taken out, and saves are left out. You get a short code like CR-7KQ2M.
Post only that code in Discord, not the log files.
Open server logs opens the logs folder.
